newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Indonesia approves new AXA venture.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia approves new AXA venture.

text.p: French insurance giant AXA said on Thursday it had won regulatory approval for a new joint-venture general insurance operation in Indonesia.
The new company, PT Asuransi AXA Indonesia, had an initial capitalisation of 15 billion rupiah (US$6.4 million), AXA said in a statement.
AXA will hold 80 percent of the shares in the company and its joint-venture partner, Indonesian conglomerate Kalbe Group, 20 percent.

PT Asuransi AXA Indonesia was formed after the acquisition by the partners earlier this year of the privately held Indonesian general insurer, PT Asuransi Permata Selat Sunda. It has now been re-licensed as a foreign joint-venture firm.

Speaking to Reuters from Jakarta, PT Asuransi AXA Indonesia general manager Philip Rowcliffe said the company would begin underwriting immediately, offering products largely based on Permata's existing portfolio.
Rowcliffe said new products would be added quickly to meet projected demand. The company can also underwrite facultative reinsurance under its licence, he added.
